name: bodyweight-wall-squat.html
instructions:
1. Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart and a few inches away. This is the starting position.
2. Slowly slide your back down the wall, bending your knees until they are at about 90 degrees.
3. Keep your back flat by pressing your lower back against the wall and keeping your chest lifted.
4. Stay in the squat position, keeping your thighs parallel to the floor.
5. Push through your heels and slowly slide back up to the starting position. This is one rep.
6. Perform the desired reps, focusing on form and controlled movement.
